newsitem.title: UK: CRICKET-ENGLISH COUNTY CHAMPIONSHIP SECOND DAY SCORES.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-ENGLISH COUNTY CHAMPIONSHIP SECOND DAY SCORES.

text.p: Close of play scores on the second day of four-day English county championship matches on Thursday:
At Lord's: Middlesex 442-8 declared (M.Ramprakash 190, O.Shah 77), Hampshire 69-2.
Northampton: Worcestershire 551 (W.Weston 205, D.Leatherdale 110, S.Rhodes 55; S.Boswell 5-94), Northamptonshire 208-3 (R.Warren 85 not out, A.Fordham 57)
The Oval: Surrey 350-9 declared (J.Ratcliffe 76, I.Ward 56; J.Wood 4-73), Durham 120-6.
Canterbury: Kent 525-9 declared (M.Fleming 138, A.Wells 109, M.Ealham 58, P.Strang 55, G.Cowdrey 53), Essex 80-5.
Blackpool: Warwickshire 139 and 241-8 (D.Brown 53; D.Shadford 4-73), Lancashire 362 (G.Lloyd 75, I.Austin 68, N.Fairbrother 60; G.Welch 6-115)
